cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Build and run docker
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && docker-compose up -d --build 2>&1 | tail -15")
print("Docker:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
